This Code shall be known as the "Santa Monica Municipal Code," and it shall be sufficient to refer to said Code as the "Santa Monica Municipal Code" in any prosecution for the violation of any provisions thereof. It shall also be sufficient to designate any ordinance adding to, amending, or repealing, said Code, or portions thereof, as an addition or amendment to, or a repeal of, the "Santa Monica Municipal Code," or a portion thereof.
(Prior code § 1100)
